name: oei-plateforme
description: Plateforme pédagogique OEI — outillage QA (contenu de cours, composants, slides)

scripts.qa:content: node tools/lint-course-content.js --strict-metadata && npm run check:syntax && npm run lint && node tools/audit-global-assignments.mjs && node tools/audit-inline-handlers.mjs && npm run test:unit && node tools/generate-index-catalog.js && node tools/check-catalog-integrity.js
scripts.qa:slides: bash tools/ui-inline-audit.sh . && node tools/security/inline-expression-audit.mjs && node tools/security/innerhtml-audit.mjs && node tools/slides/deck-schema-validate.mjs && node tools/slides/refactor-guard.mjs && npm run qa:slides:metrics && node --test tests/slides/*.test.mjs && npm run docs:api:check
